description.narrative: Efforts to reform the public administration and judiciary and create a robust anti-corruption system have largely failed to remove illicit assets attained through corruption and return them to public coffers. This has led to a widespread public perception of a political system in which a business/political strata is above the law and able to enrich themselves while the rest must resort to migration to better functioning countries in order to have a chance to prosper through merit and hard work. The project will support the establishment of the entire unexplained wealth confiscation system in Kosovo through a three pronged approach. First, the project will support public outreach efforts to explain the necessity and aim of confiscating unexplained wealth, including assuaging concerns of arbitrary confiscation of citizens’ rightfully owned property and combatting fake news from wealthy business and political lobbies that have a vested interest in retaining their wealth derived from corruption through maintaining the status quo. Second, the project will support the establishment of the Bureau through policy advice on internal processes and structures, transparent recruitment procedures, effective internal oversight and capacity building on undertaking unexplained wealth investigations. Third, the project will provide capacity building to judges tasked with hearing cases involving unexplained wealth to ensure proper implementation of the law and full legal safeguards.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
